text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: This is it. We've reached the finals.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
We're facing <chrname> on a stage where she<n>perhaps
shines the brightest of all.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Right! After all the time we've spent<n>together, we
owe it to our trainees to<n>cheer them on with all our
might!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a little. I've been striving to have<n>you succeed,
and to show Trainer <username><n>that I have it in me to exceed
all<n>expectations.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But I know we've both grown<n>stronger because of
this. We've<n>been able to overcome every loss<n>and
conquer every weakness. So I<n>know you can do
this.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. This time I'm ready. I've gotten<n>so strong
and fast.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Get out there, Meek. Show our<n>strongest rival
exactly what you're<n>capable of!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The final race of the URA Finale is<n>about to begin!
